texto: Yaldabaoth said, "I am a jealous God." And by saying it, he showed that another God exists.
Now the Savior told John what happened to his mother, Sophia.
For she had brought forth Yaldabaoth alone, without her partner.
And John listened, so that he could write it down.
Then the mother began to move to and fro.
She saw that something was lacking, because the brightness of her light grew dim.
And she became dark, because her partner had not agreed with her.
For the first ruler had taken a great power from her.
And John said, "Lord, what does it mean, that she moved to and fro?"
The Savior smiled and said, "Do not think it is as Moses said, over the waters."
For the book of Moses says the spirit moved over the face of the waters.
"No," the Savior said. "It was like this."
When she saw the evil that had happened, and the theft her son had done, she repented.
Forgetfulness came over her, in the darkness of not knowing.
And she began to be ashamed.
She did not dare to go back up. So she moved about, here and there.
And this moving is the going to and fro.
Meanwhile the proud one, her son, held the power he took from his mother.
For he did not know. He thought no one existed except his mother alone.
He saw the great crowd of angels he had made.
And he raised himself up above them all.
Then the mother saw that the child of darkness she had made was not complete.
And she knew it was because her partner had not agreed with her.
She repented, weeping very much.
And her repentance rose up as a prayer, toward the light above.
The whole Fullness heard the prayer of her repentance.
The Fullness is the world of light above, where the great beings of light live.
And all of them praised the Invisible Spirit for her sake.
And the Invisible Spirit, the pure light above everything, agreed.
And when the Invisible Spirit agreed, a holy spirit poured over her.
It poured from the whole Fullness, from all the beings of light together.
And her partner came down to her, through the whole Fullness.
He came to set right what she lacked.
Then she was taken up, but not to her own aeon.
Her own aeon was her place in the light, with the great light Eleleth.
She was set above her son, the first ruler.
She would stay in the ninth heaven, until she had set right what she lacked.
Then a voice came down from the high aeon of heaven.
It said, "Man exists, and the Son of Man."
The first ruler, Yaldabaoth, heard the voice.
He thought the voice had come from his mother.
For he did not know where it came from.
So Sophia wept and repented, and she was lifted up above her son.
Next time: the First Human shows his image in the waters, and the rulers' heavens shake.
Thank you for listening to the secret book with me.
Why do you think Sophia did not dare to go back to the light? Tell me in the comments.
